intended_object: Given a class of morphisms W of a category C that is compatible with a relation homRel on hom-sets (W f ↔ W g when f ~ g), this is the induced class of morphisms on the quotient category C/homRel: the images of morphisms in W. Inferred from the docstring and the module documentation.
explanation: The quotient category has the same objects as C. The body puts a morphism f : ⟨X⟩ ⟶ ⟨Y⟩ in the class exactly when f is the image under the quotient functor of some f' : X ⟶ Y with W f'. This is the induced class. The HasQuotient hypothesis is not used in the body, but the library needs it to prove quotient_iff: the image of f is in the class iff W f. Mathlib's general `MorphismProperty.map` is not the same object, because it also adds every morphism isomorphic (in the arrow category) to an image. Here the strict image is what is intended, and the quotient functor is the identity on objects and surjective on morphisms. The definition is stated for any category, any MorphismProperty and any relation stable under pre- and postcomposition, so it is at its natural generality.
